cause_detail: Existing gidi-finance-v1 target-head error, inherited unchanged by the v2 type/target path. Not caused by V8, not a browser-runtime bug, not a tokenizer/offset bug: input_ids, offsets and character mapping are identical in Python and TypeScript. `vinamilk` is split into ` v` [7,9) `in` [9,11) `amil` [11,15) `k` [15,16). Every runtime tags ` v` B-TARGET (logit ~10) and `amil` strongly O; the tag on `in` is a three-way near-tie (|logit gap| < 0.6), so the span is `v` or `vin` depending on float numerics. Both are incorrect.
status: open: for future target-model work; no production change
